text.text_excerpt: Take out and dine-in available right now. Everything was clean (cleaning was constant while we were there), everyone was masked and gloved, and food was delicious. If you're looking for atmosphere by the way, theirs can't be beat. On to the food - I don't know how they make the breakfast so tasty at this location, but they do! The build your omelette is my favorite because you get so much food, and it's fresh. Always go with the biscuit instead of toast as it's light and buttery. Their grits have a great texture though I find them to be under flavored sometimes, which they do on purpose so that you can make them to how you like them. I know it's not a 5 star restaurant, but you can't go wrong with Dot's Diner. It's cheap, it's filling, and it's comfort food. Plus, there's hardly any wait! (Funny story: as my husband and I arrived at Dot's Diner were IMMEDIATELY seated, I get a pop-up notification from Yelp telling me to check out the Ruby Slipper, current wait time: 45 minutes!!!! hahahaha, heck no! I'll take immediate seating & classic, cheap breakfast fare over a 45 minute wait for more expensive, smaller portions, and fewer options). I got the Big Dot because I couldn't make up my mind on what to eat, like usual. It's two eggs, 2 strips of bacon, 2 sausage patties, 2 pancakes, hash browns, grits, and toast. My hubb...

As I have said before, I am not much of a breakfast guy, but when it is the weekend and the lady wants to go try a new spot, you do what you are told sometimes. Thankfully, my lady is awesome and knows the best places to try. That my friends, is why I am writing about Dots Diner. If you listen to the radio on your drive into work in New Orleans, you have heard the commercials. Ole Dot letting you know to come on in and enjoy yourself. It is everything you can think of from that commercial and more! The food is amazing! I ordered the chicken and Waffles, which did not come together, (I was not mad at all at this by the way!), a grilled biscuit, and some bacon. It was a perfect meal to have...
